title: Simplifying Administrative and Reporting Processes for Deputies Appointed under Mental Capacity Act
what_it_is: Simplifying Administrative and Reporting Processes for Deputies Appointed under Mental Capacity Act

sections.label: Deputy reporting under Mental Capacity Act
sections.summary: MSF states Court-appointed deputies must file annual reports to the Office of the Public Guardian, and it has reduced deputy burden through online submission, a finance tracker and monthly workshops.

sentences.speaker: Ms Denise Phua Lay Peng
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Social and Family Development whether the Ministry will review the administrative and reporting framework for deputies appointed under the Mental Capacity Act, with a view to simplifying procedures and easing the compliance burden, while maintaining safeguards for the persons they serve.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Mr Goh Pei Ming) (for t
sentences.text: he Minister for Social and Family Development): Mr Speaker, under the Mental Capacity Act, Court-appointed deputies must submit an annual report to the Office of the Public Guardian (OPG).

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Mr Goh Pei Ming) (for t
sentences.text: This report is an important safeguard against potential abuse as it requires deputies to set out how they have discharged their responsibilities under the Court order, which includes accounting for decisions made on behalf of the mentally incapacitated persons and how they have managed such persons’ property and affairs.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Mr Goh Pei Ming) (for t
sentences.text: The Ministry for Social and Family Development (MSF) has been working to reduce the burden for deputies, including online submission of reports and a built-in finance tracker.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Mr Goh Pei Ming) (for t
sentences.text: OPG organises monthly workshops to guide deputies to fulfil responsibilities and requirements for the annual reports.

sections.label: Banks' inconsistent support for families
sections.summary: A Member asks whether MSF will lead a small inter-agency work group, possibly including volunteers, to coordinate help for family-member deputies facing these problems.

sentences.speaker: Ms Denise Phua Lay Peng
sentences.text: The banks are not very consistent in supporting these families.

sentences.speaker: Ms Denise Phua Lay Peng
sentences.text: So, my supplementary question would be this: would MSF take a lead in setting up a small, maybe inter-agency work group, even including volunteers, to look into these problems that are really faced by the deputies who are family members and try to coordinate the efforts to assist them.

sections.label: MSF engagement and review of deputyship
sections.summary: MSF acknowledges the feedback, says it regularly engages stakeholders including deputies and the public, and will continuously review the application and reporting processes and user experience.

sentences.speaker: Mr Goh Pei Ming
sentences.text: Having said so, I acknowledge the comments and feedback from the Member.

sentences.speaker: Mr Goh Pei Ming
sentences.text: We regularly and continuously engage key stakeholders, including deputies and prospective deputies, as well as members of the public.

sentences.speaker: Mr Goh Pei Ming
sentences.text: We will continuously review how we can improve both the application process and the reporting process, as well as the overall user experience in going through the deputyship journey.

sections.label: Threshold for statutory declaration
sections.summary: A Member asks whether a threshold could be set allowing a statutory declaration or something else instead of a full deputyship.

sentences.speaker: Mr Patrick Tay Teck Guan (Pioneer)
sentences.text: Is there a way to set some threshold where we allow maybe a statutory declaration or something else, rather than a full deputyship, to be able to handle this?
